timeline.message: Add comment explaining the use of assertBusy
timeline.author: Nick Tindall

timeline.body:
This failure is very difficult to reproduce (and understand), in discussion with @tlrx, he suggested perhaps `writeCount` might return zero temporarily due to contention on the `LongAdder`. If that's true, this should fix the test, if not, we'll know to look elsewhere.

Closes #112384

timeline.author: Nick Tindall

timeline.body: We could also log a message including all the `NodeCachesStatsResponse` when we fail (for troubleshooting), but if the theory is correct that's just extra log noise.
